meta.name: google-ads-landing
meta.description: Score and diagnose Google Ads landing pages. Use when asked to audit a landing page, check landing page quality, diagnose high-CTR but low-conversion-rate ad groups, improve Quality Score's Landing Page Experience component, or compare an ad group's messaging against its landing page. Trigger on "landing page audit", "landing page score", "landing page quality", "why is my conversion rate low", "LPX", "landing page experience", "ad to page match", or when `/google-ads-audit` surfaces a high-CTR / low-CVR ad group.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断谷歌广告落地页质量并给出优化建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在投放谷歌广告，想提升落地页体验和转化率。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose Google Ads landing page quality and get optimization tips.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run Google Ads and want to improve landing page experience and conversion rates.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以评估 Google Ads 落地页的质量，从信息匹配、页面速度、移动体验、信任信号和表单/CTA 五个维度打分，并估算修复后能带来的利润提升。
howto.when: 当你要求审计落地页、检查页面质量、诊断高点击率但低转化率的广告组，或比较广告文案与页面是否匹配时触发。

say.note: Claude 会抓取页面并给出评分和修复建议。

say.text: 检查我的广告组‘夏季促销’的落地页质量
say.note: Claude 会拉取该广告组的最终网址并评分。

say.text: 为什么我的转化率这么低？
say.note: Claude 会分析落地页问题并估算利润提升。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can score Google Ads landing pages across five dimensions: message match, page speed, mobile experience, trust signals, and form/CTA. It provides measurements and estimates the profit lift from fixing top issues.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to audit a landing page, check landing page quality, diagnose high-CTR but low-CVR ad groups, or compare ad copy against the landing page.

say_en.note: Claude will fetch the page and provide scores and fixes.

say_en.text: Check the landing page quality for my ad group 'Summer Sale'
say_en.note: Claude will pull the final URLs for that ad group and score them.

say_en.text: Why is my conversion rate so low?
say_en.note: Claude will diagnose landing page issues and estimate profit lift.
